effect.en: For five turns, heals all Pokémon on the ground for 1/16 max HP each turn and strengthens their Grass moves to 1.5× their power.

flavor.ko: 5턴 동안 그래스필드로 만든다. 땅에 있으면 매 턴 회복한다. 풀타입의 위력이 올라간다.
flavor.en: The user turns the ground into Grassy Terrain for five turns. This restores the HP of Pokémon on the ground a little every turn and powers up Grass-type moves.
